model.title: European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund: simplification and transposition of the WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies

summary.text: This proposal seeks to simplify rules governing fishing subsidies and align them with international agreements on reducing harmful fishing practices. It aims to make it easier for countries to follow these rules while ensuring compliance with global trade standards on fisheries support.
